Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: French Kweebec relaxes for a moment, though some wariness remains in his expression.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: Well, after we left things off in a not-so-good state last time, I was thinking that maybe we could have some fun today.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: ... but I am not sure how one has « fun » on Kweebdrasil. In un sens social, I mean.

Line.Text: Ah, I should have asked Goth Kweebec ahead of time ! But these things keep slipping my mind nowadays.
